title: My Apps Apps Index
description: Catalog index consumed from apps.json, keyed by relative blueprint path.

icon.description: Optional App Store icon. Supports http(s) URLs, root-relative paths, image data URIs, Dashicon class names, or short text/emoji icons.

icon_background.description: Optional tile background behind a Dashicon or text icon: a CSS colour or gradient.

icon_color.description: Optional glyph colour for a Dashicon or text icon.

icon_shadow.description: Optional glyph shadow: true for the default soft shadow, or a CSS text-shadow value.
